The Entergy Regional State Committee Working Group (ERSCWG) will host a public work session (in-person & Webex) in the central business district of New Orleans, Louisiana (exact location noticed later). The purpose of this Working Group meeting is to receive presentations, statements, and questions on matters related to the Entergy Transmission System, the MISO RTO, seams agreements with neighboring regions and/or RTOs, and other related matters.  

If you are planning to attend this meeting in-person, please Register by 4:00 PM ET / 3:00 PM CT on October 16.

Interested parties who want to present should contact Barton Norfleet (barton.norfleet@psc.ms.gov) and Chad Allen (callen@misoenergy.org) as soon as possible. Presentations, statements, or questions should be submitted to Barton and Chad by the close of business on Friday, October 16, 2026 by 4:00 PM ET / 3:00 PM CT. If no stakeholder responds to this request for presentations, statements, or questions, the ERSC WG Chair may cancel this work session.
